title: Signed webhook notifications when tasks finish
body:
Teams want Slack/CI hooks when a task completes or fails.

Backend:
1. New `backend/src/services/webhookNotifier.ts`:
   - `signPayload(secret: string, body: string): string` → `sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256>`;
   - `notifyWebhook(config, payload)` POSTs JSON with headers `Content-Type: application/json`, `X-Pullwright-Event: task.completed|task.failed`, `X-Pullwright-Signature: <signPayload(...)>`; retries up to 3 times on network errors or 5xx with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s); never throws — failures are logged.
2. Webhook settings per signed-in user in Redis key `webhook:{login}` → `{ url, secret, createdAt }`:
   - `GET /api/settings/webhook` → `{ url, createdAt }` or `{ url: null }` (never return the secret);
   - `PUT /api/settings/webhook` with `{ url }` — must be an `https://` URL (400 otherwise); generates a random 32-byte hex secret and returns `{ url, secret }` **once**;
   - `DELETE /api/settings/webhook` removes it.
3. Orchestrator: when a task completes or fails, if the task owner has a webhook, send `{ event, taskId, issueUrl, status, prUrl?, reason?, metrics: { costUsd, durationMs } }` (fire-and-forget, must not delay or break the task).
4. Vitest tests for `signPayload` and the retry/backoff logic (mock `fetch` and timers).

Frontend:
5. `getWebhook`, `saveWebhook(url)`, `deleteWebhook()` in `frontend/src/api/client.ts`.
6. A **Webhook** card on the Dashboard: URL input + Save, shows the secret once after saving (with a copy button), and Remove.

`npx tsc -b` must pass in backend and frontend.

summary:
Implemented signed webhook support end-to-end. Added backend/src/services/webhookNotifier.ts (signPayload and notifyWebhook with HMAC-SHA256 signature and exponential backoff retries). Added Redis-backed webhook settings API in backend/src/api/router.ts (GET/PUT/DELETE /api/settings/webhook) storing webhook:{login} and returning secret only once on PUT. Wired orchestrator (backend/src/Orchestrator/index.ts) to send fire-and-forget webhook notifications on task completion and failure. Added Vitest unit tests for signPayload and notifyWebhook retry/backoff at backend/src/services/__tests__/webhookNotifier.test.ts and a vitest.setup.ts placeholder. Added frontend API client functions getWebhook, saveWebhook, deleteWebhook in frontend/src/api/client.ts and a Webhook card UI with SecretDisplay and WebhookCard components integrated into Dashboard. Verified changes by running: backend type-check (npx tsc --noEmit -p .) — passed; backend tests (npm test) — passed (including new tests); frontend build (npx tsc -b) — passed. Assumptions: req.session?.login is available for identifying webhook owner; Redis client createRedisClient from backend/src/config/redis.ts is used and reachable. Note: I initially modified BullMQ worker to pass githubLogin through job data but then reverted to keep original behavior; instead orchestrator.run was extended to accept githubLogin and Worker was left consistent with original signature (no behavioral breaking).
